title: Wave and Return: The Bent Fist, the Figure-Eight, and the Science of a Restrained Hand
creator: Cory Snell
description:
A free, evidence-based companion to the System of Inevitability, Book 2: the bent fist, whole-body wave striking, figure-eight motion, breath, and the science and ethics of a restrained hand. By Cory Snell, creator of the System of Inevitability. Book 2 of the series Companions to the System of Inevitability.

Also in this series, Companions to the System of Inevitability:

  • Book 1: Walking and Turning
  • Book 3: Shape and Choice
  • Book 4: Lens and Lattice
  • Book 5: Nucleus and Orbit
  • Book 6: Arc and Iron
